relevance_note: Case report of two Italian children with ATS and biallelic SLC2A10 variants: "In Patient 1 genotyping disclosed the maternal c.685C>T transition and the paternal c.756C>A transversion".
method_note: Hand extraction from the full text (no tables in the paper); JSON assembled with a short Python script whose values were all typed from my reading. Scope: Patients 1 and 2; their parents, inferred as tested carriers from 'the maternal c.685C>T', 'the paternal c.756C>A', 'the maternal c.1334delG' and the father's heterozygous c.691C>T; the unaffected heterozygous younger brother of Patient 2; and previously published people with an individual-level variant: the Kurdish patient homozygous for c.756C>A [3] and three Spanish affected siblings compound heterozygous for c.692G>A and c.1334delG [4]. The Belgian family homozygous for c.685C>T [4] was not given rows because the number of people is not stated. Parents were described as 'unaffected'/'healthy' and the brother as 'unaffected'; no feature rows were made from these global statements and their checklists are 'not reported'. Per D-27, global negative statements ('no cutaneous or skeletal involvement is noted' for Patient 1, 'No cutaneous, ocular, or tegument involvement' for Patient 2, 'Echocardiography excluded heart disease', 'Chest radiography, cranial and abdominal ultrasounds were normal') were recorded as excluded at the level named and were not used to exclude narrower checklist items (lax skin, scoliosis, pectus, arachnodactyly, ventricular hypertrophy). Patient 1's vascular features come partly from the Figure 1 legend (MRA). 'Bilateral reduction of peripheral pulmonary branches' and 'mild hypoplasia of descending and abdominal aorta' were not counted as stenosis on the checklist. For Patient 2, 'severe stenoses, elongation, and tortuosity of pulmonary arteries branches, aortic arch, sovraortic trunks, and iliac arteries' was read distributively (all three findings for each vessel group); the sentence is ambiguous about which vessels are stenotic, which affects the two stenosis checklist items. Zygosity 'compound heterozygous' for the patients rests on 'heterozygous for two different SLC2A10mutations' (both patients, named group) plus maternal/paternal origin; for Patient 2 also 'in compound heterozygosity with the c.1334delG mutation, like in our patient'. Variant type for c.1334delG recorded as 'other' from the authors' word 'microdeletion' (frameshift not derived from the HGVS). is_proband left null for Patients 1 and 2: the paper does not call either a proband and it reports two patients. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients set true from 'Pulmonary hypertension treatment was carried out as previously reported [10]', which implies Patient 2's treatment was published in ref [10]; this reading is uncertain. No contradictions found.
